rubric: 0 absent/unrelated; 1 token cues; 2 weak adaptation; 3 recognizable with material deviations; 4 faithful with only minor deviations; 5 exceptionally close 3D translation. Score likeness, not technical validity.
scope: Holistic category scores after separately opening all ten actual candidate PNGs; novel rear/top anatomy checked for coherence, not against unseen concept geometry. No penalty for absent illustrative background or title.

views.observation: Recognizable teal crocodilian, gold spines, rope and barnacles. Thick plain forelimb dominates; short boxy head and straight narrow keel lack the broad expressive maw of the hero.
Heavy planted stance reads, but narrow straight central strip divides a tunnel-like mouth. Eyes are barely visible under the forehead; no strong angry brow expression.
Continuous curved tail and four supporting limbs. Barrel body and plate steps read as chunky stacked panels rather than subtly broken reptilian scutes.
Long crocodilian tail and raised shoulders, but head is a straight rectangular grille. Repeated needle teeth are too uniform; large cream cheek and slab forelimb simplify character.
Visible amber eye and barnacle clusters identify Keelmaw. Curled tail holds across side views. Tiny round button eye and high block torso weaken predatory look.
Full anatomy survives overhead; thick hooked tail, paired planted feet, three rope straps, dorsal plates and spikes are actual geometry. Head is boxy and shell plating too regular.
Whole body readable, no crop. Rectangular short snout and thin central keel dominate; front-opening teeth are hard to see and amber eyes disappear.
Complete hind anatomy and tail are present, but ropes are thin zigzag ribbons with bright terminal blocks at this angle. Tail and limbs have sparse surface variation.
Mouth has real volume and tooth rows, barnacle holes read. Face still feels square and toy-like, rather than the concept's broad menacing crocodile.
Strong identifier set and consistent material palette. Thin strap/large barnacle contrast, simpler jaw and broad nearly unbroken limb facets remain prominent.
